clue.text: Live and die in old-time subservience

indicators.note: in tells us the living and dying go inside the word for old-time

parts.note: once means formerly, in old times
to be is to live or exist
taken as written

explanation.surface: Living and dying in servitude, as in the bad old days.
explanation.definitionFit: Obedience is dutiful submission to authority, a synonym of subservience.

clue.text: An Irish howler!

parts.note: a howler is a blunder, and Irish ones are the subject of jokes, but here it is a wailing female spirit of Irish folklore

explanation.definitionFit: In Irish legend a wailing spirit howls to foretell a death.

clue.text: Grandee's letters fomenting disorder

indicators.note: the letters of the nobleman's title are stirred up, fomenting trouble, into a new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A Spanish nobleman's correspondence is stirring up unrest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letters' looks like a grandee's correspondence; it means the letters of the word itself, which 'fomenting' stirs into a new arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: To derange is to throw into confusion, a verb synonym of disorder.

clue.text: The hour for making that last bid

definitions.text: The hour for making that last bid

parts.words: The hour for making that last bid
parts.note: the very last moment, the final hour before midnight or a deadline, when a final attempt is made

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'the eleventh hour' means the last possible moment for action.

clue.text: Bearing blossom in march or April

definitions.text: Bearing blossom in march or April

parts.words: Bearing blossom in march or April
parts.note: the spring festival, which falls in March or April and is decked with lilies; bearing suggests a compass direction too

explanation.definitionFit: The Christian spring feast is a movable date always in March or April, with blossom and lilies.

clue.text: One page is being rewritten in this secret work

indicators.note: a page that is rewritten has its words rearranged, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A spy rewrites a page of a document in the course of a covert mission.
explanation.definitionFit: Espionage is spying, the secret work of gathering intelligence.

clue.text: Appeared hurt after the campaign, but sang

indicators.note: after places the bleeding behind the campaign in the answer

parts.note: a war is a military campaign
bled means showed signs of injury, appeared hurt

explanation.surface: A soldier, wounded after the campaign, nonetheless burst into song.
explanation.definitionFit: To warble is to sing with trills, as a bird does.

clue.text: Flatterers popular with fault-finding folk

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
censors are critics who find fault

explanation.surface: Sycophants manage to stay in favour with critical people.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who burn incense before someone figuratively heap praise on them, so they are flatterers.

clue.text: The way article should be put into a waste-receptacle — fast

indicators.note: put into tells us the way and the article go inside the receptacle

parts.note: a bin is a receptacle for rubbish
ST is short for street, a way
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Instructions for disposing of an item: the street's rubbish goes in the bin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' at the end means go without food, not quick.
explanation.definitionFit: To fast is to abstain from food, an idiomatic sense of the verb.

clue.text: Caught without cash, sounded far from happy

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside means the trapping word goes around the cash

parts.note: snared means caught in a trap
L stands for pound, money

explanation.surface: Someone caught short of money grumbled unhappily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but means outside: L (pound, from librum) sits inside SNARED.
explanation.definitionFit: Snarled means growled angrily, a sound of displeasure.

clue.text: This will ensure one doesn't get needled!

definitions.text: This will ensure one doesn't get needled!

parts.words: This will ensure one doesn't get needled!
parts.note: needled usually means annoyed, but here it means pricked by a sewing needle, which a fingertip cap prevents

explanation.definitionFit: A seamstress wears a small metal cap on the finger to push the needle without being pricked.

clue.text: The vocalist can use the new version

indicators.note: a new version of the words rearranges their letters

explanation.surface: A singer is told she may use the updated arrangement of the song.
explanation.definitionFit: A chanteuse is a female singer, especially in a nightclub, so a vocalist.

clue.text: Took advantage of people's generosity and cleaned up

definitions.meaning: wiped clean with a soft absorbent pad

explanation.surface: A freeloader who exploited others' kindness then wiped the place clean.
explanation.definitionFit: A cadger lives off others, and the same verb means wiping with a soft absorbent sea creature's skeleton.

clue.text: A royal lady among many featured in the newspapers

indicators.note: featured in tells us the pieces go inside the newspapers

parts.note: the press means the newspapers collectively
in means among
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a lot

explanation.surface: A royal woman is one of many photographed in the papers.
explanation.definitionFit: A princess is a king's daughter, a female royal.

clue.text: Get warm again here perhaps, returning thanks

indicators.note: perhaps suggests a possible rearrangement of the word here
returning means the word for thanks is read backwards

parts.note: ta is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: Someone thanks the host for warming up the food again.
explanation.definitionFit: To reheat is to make something hot once more, as with leftovers.

clue.text: Respect as of right always in French church

parts.note: ever means always
en is French for in
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Respect, as a right, is always shown in a French church.
explanation.definitionFit: Reverence is deep respect, a close synonym.

clue.text: A beast with some complaint making a charge

parts.note: an ass is a donkey, a beast
ailing means suffering an illness or complaint

explanation.surface: An animal with an ailment rushes forward to attack.
explanation.definitionFit: Assailing is attacking, as an army does when charging.

clue.text: It's a party — show a bit of leg, understand?

parts.note: the shin is part of the leg
dig is slang for understand

explanation.surface: Someone at a lively party is told to show a bit of leg, get it?
explanation.definitionFit: A shindig is a noisy party or celebration.

clue.text: Ship club many a boy will join

parts.note: an iron is a golf club
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a lot
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: Boys sign up to join a ship's club.
explanation.definitionFit: An ironclad was a 19th-century warship armoured with iron plates.

clue.text: Fancy cereal kept under cover

indicators.note: kept under places the cereal below the cover in this down answer

parts.note: a cap is a covering
rice is a cereal grain

explanation.surface: A fancy cereal is stored in a covered container.
explanation.definitionFit: A caprice is a whim, a passing fancy.

clue.text: Break concerning the engineer on a sea-going vessel

parts.note: re means about or concerning
CE is short for chief engineer
SS is steamship

explanation.surface: A break regarding the ship's engineer.
explanation.definitionFit: A recess is a break or pause, as between sessions of parliament.

clue.text: A game six-footer

definitions.meaning: a bat-and-ball sport played in whites
a chirping insect with six legs

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a bat-and-ball sport and a chirping insect with six feet.

clue.text: Quiet girl on the river

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A quiet girl sits by the river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Shannon is Ireland's longest river, an example of one.

clue.text: Black's behind time, so may be eliminated

indicators.note: behind puts black after time in the answer

parts.note: an era is a period of time
sable is black in heraldry

explanation.surface: A black mark that is out of date can be wiped away.
explanation.definitionFit: Something erasable can be rubbed out or removed.

clue.text: Settles for slight adjustment

indicators.note: an adjustment rearranges the letters of the word slight

explanation.surface: Someone agrees to a small change.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird lights on a branch, alighting or coming to rest, as a verb synonym of settles.

clue.text: Indicate revised figure all the same

indicators.note: revised means the letters of indicate are changed into another order

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a figure

explanation.surface: Show the corrected number, regardless.
explanation.definitionFit: Identical means exactly alike, so all the same.

clue.text: Hype for a hearing device that won't help anyone's hearing!

definitions.text: device that won't help anyone's hearing!

parts.note: to give ear is to give a hearing
a plug is a piece of promotional hype

explanation.surface: Publicity for a hearing aid that actually blocks sound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' joins the pieces: the plug comes after the ear in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A plug worn in the ear deadens sound, the opposite of an aid.

clue.text: Fly endlessly with a top man going to pieces

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the word fly is removed

parts.note: a king is the man at the top

explanation.surface: A ruler collapses while trying to fly.
explanation.definitionFit: Flaking means crumbling into small pieces, or in slang falling apart.

clue.text: The objective of the shy

parts.note: shy looks like a timid adjective but is a fairground stall where balls are thrown at nuts on posts

explanation.walkthrough: A coconut shy is a British fairground game of knocking nuts off stands with thrown balls.
explanation.definitionFit: At a fairground shy, the target to knock off its stand is a hairy tropical nut.

clue.text: Gives a smooth finish to sound building material

parts.note: sands means smooths with abrasive paper
a tone is a sound

explanation.surface: A craftsman finishes off good building stone smoothly.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandstone is a sedimentary rock used in construction.
